description_en: Queries the objects of a Browser Monitoring application by process identifier (PID)
description_zh: 根据前端监控应用Pid返回前端监控应用对象
kebab_example: aliyun arms get-retcode-app-by-pid --pid b590lhguqs@9781be0f44dXXXX --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetRetcodeAppByPid

parameters.help_en: The PID of the application. To obtain the PID of the application, perform the following steps: Log on to the Application Real-Time Monitoring Service (ARMS) console. In the left-side navigation pane, choose Browser Monitoring > Browser Monitoring. On the Browser Monitoring page, click the name of the application. The URL in the address bar contains the PID of the application. The PID is in the pid=xxx format. The PID is usually percent encoded as xxx%40xxx. You must modify this value to remove the percent encoding. For example, if the PID in the URL is xxx%4074xxx, you must replace %40 with the at sign (@) to obtain xxx@74xxx
parameters.help_zh: 应用PID。在ARMS控制台的前端监控>前端列表页面单击目标应用名称。此时浏览器地址栏中的URL即包含应用的pid，格式为pid=xxx。由于浏览器进行了编码，因此需要对pid稍作修改。例如，如果URL中包含的pid为xxx%4074xxx，则需要将%40替换为@，即：xxx@74xxx
parameters.name: pid

fields.help_zh: 标签值。非必填，可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以```acs:```开头，不能包含```http://```或者```https://```
fields.name: value

parameters.help_zh: 标签键值对，当您未输入ResourceIds参数时必填。取值说明如下：                              key：标签键，字符长度范围[1,128]。                                 value：标签值，字符长度范围[1,128]。                                 区分大小写。如果指定多个标签，则会为指定资源同时创建并绑定多个标签。同一个资源上的同一个标签键只能对应一个标签值。如果您尝试添加已有标签键，则对应的标签值会更新为新值。不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://

RetcodeApp.description_zh: 前端监控应用返回数据

AppId.description_en: The ID of the application. The parameter is an auto-increment parameter

AppName.description_en: The name of the application that is monitored by Browser Monitoring

Pid.description_en: The process identifier (PID) of the application

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group. You can obtain the resource group ID in the Resource Management console
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: 资源组ID，您可以通过资源管理控制台获取

RetcodeAppType.description_en:
The type of the application that is monitored by Browser Monitoring. Valid values:

`web`: web application
`weex`: Weex mobile app
`mini_dd`: DingTalk mini program
`mini_alipay`: Alipay mini program
`mini_wx`: WeChat mini program
`mini_common`: mini program on other platforms
